content.bridge_context: Understanding our surroundings and the components that make up the environment.

units.title: What is Environment?
units.explanation: Everything that surrounds us - people, places, things, and nature.
units.dual_language_instruction: List three natural things in your environment. / अपने पर्यावरण की तीन प्राकृतिक चीजों की सूची बनाएं।

units.title: Biotic and Abiotic
units.explanation: Biotic: Living things (Plants, Animals). Abiotic: Non-living things (Land, Air, Water).
units.dual_language_instruction: Is a rock biotic or abiotic? / क्या चट्टान जैविक (biotic) है या अजैविक (abiotic)?
